description.description: The description as Tiptap JSON text. An empty string if the issue has no description.

descriptionString.description: The indexed text of the description.

resolutionSnippet.description: Up to 500 characters of the last top-level comment before the issue moved to a completed state. An empty string if there is no such comment.

issueNumber.description: The team identifier and the number, for example "ENG-12".

assigneeId.description: An empty string if nobody has the issue.

distance.description: The cosine distance to the query. The field is absent if the match is by words only.

relevanceScore.description: 1 minus `distance`. The field is absent when `distance` is absent.

401.description: The request has no valid token or session.
